name: neo-angband-mod-upstream-catchup
description: Changes upstream Angband accepted after the 4.2.6 tag Neo Angband is pinned to, as a mod
author: neostryder (RPGM Tools)
//private: Not published to npm, and not intended to be. A mod is distributed as a FOLDER the
game fetches - manifest.json plus plugin.js, at a tag, verified against a digest
recorded at install. npm is not in that path, and publishing would create a second
way to get this mod that nothing checks.
//dependencies: The engine is a devDependency, never a dependency. plugin.js receives it as
ctx.core at load time; a runtime dependency would mean a second copy of the
engine's module state living inside the mod, which the builder refuses outright.
So it is here for TYPES and for the tests, which bind the PUBLISHED 4.2.6 content
pack against the PUBLISHED engine - the versions a player runs. Every name in a
ported .prf line is a lookup into that content, so a test against a hand-built
registry would be asserting its own fixture.
The mod SDK's plugin builder is what tools/build.mjs runs, and validateManifest is
what the manifest test checks against.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check

//allowScripts: npm 12 blocks a dependency postinstall unless it is named here; npm 10, which this
repo's CI still runs on Node 22, just runs it. Denied rather than approved because it
was measured to be unnecessary: esbuild resolves its binary through the platform
postinstall skipped. Written down so the two npm versions do not quietly disagree.
